title: A direct sampling method for magnetic induction tomography
summary: This paper proposes a direct sampling method for the inverse problem of magnetic induction tomography (MIT). Our approach defines a class of point spread functions with explicit expressions, which are computed via inner products, leading to a simple and fast imaging process. We then prove that these point spread functions decay with distance, establishing the theoretical basis of the algorithm.
